content.introduction: The Federal Open Market Committee met on April 28-29, 2026, and released minutes on May 20, 2026. The meeting was held at the Board of Governors' offices. The Federal Reserve's primary goal is to maintain a safe, flexible, and stable monetary and financial system.

# [Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System _The Federal Reserve, the central bank of the United States, provides the nation with a safe, flexible, and stable monetary and financial system._](https://www.federalreserve.gov/default.htm "Link to Home Page"). *   [Federal Reserve Banks](https://www.federalreserve.gov/aboutthefed/federal-reserve-system.htm). *   [Federal Reserve Bank and Branch Directors](https://www.federalreserve.gov/aboutthefed/directors/about.htm). *   [Federal Reserve Balance Sheet Developments](https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/publications/balance-sheet-developments-report.htm). *   [Board and Reserve Bank Actions](https://www.federalreserve.gov/supervisionreg/board-and-reserve-bank-actions.htm). *   [State Member Banks Supervised by the Federal Reserve](https://www.federalreserve.gov/supervisionreg/state-member-banks-supervised-federal-reserve.htm). *   [Federal Reserve's Key Policies for the Provision of Financial Services](https://www.federalreserve.gov/paymentsystems/pfs_about.htm). 3.   [Federal Open Market Committee](https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomc.htm). A joint meeting of the Federal Open Market Committee and the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System was held in the offices of the Board of Governors on Tuesday, April 28, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. and continued on Wednesday, April 29, 2026, at 9:00 a.m.[1](https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomcminutes20260429.htm#fn1 "footnote 1")[](https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomcminutes20260429.htm). Alyssa Arute,[3](https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomcminutes20260429.htm#fn3 "footnote 3")[](https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomcminutes20260429.htm) Assistant Director, Division of Reserve Bank Operations and Payment Systems, Board. Kurt Kostyu,[8](https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomcminutes20260429.htm#fn8 "footnote 8")[](https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomcminutes20260429.htm) Capital Markets Trading Principal, Federal Reserve Bank of New York.
